title: THE UNSUPERVISED BASTARD
readings: Four arms. No plan. The universe has asked me to stop touching things.
I checked the cliff for a warning sign. Apparently I was the warning sign.

title: THE FOUR-ARMED LIABILITY
readings: All the tools are on the table. I have eaten the instructions.
Four hands doing sleight of hand. Somehow the rabbit owes me money.

title: THE SUSPECT PRIESTESS
readings: My inner voice knows things. My inner mouth keeps telling people.
The secret knowledge was a recipe. I have summoned a fucking quiche.

title: THE BROODMARE OF BAD IDEAS
readings: Something is growing. I refuse to tell the landlord what.
I nurtured a small problem. It now has a conservatory and three children.

title: THE EMPEROR OF FUCK ALL
readings: I rule this kingdom with an iron hoof. The kingdom is a folding chair.
A coup has occurred. The chair has folded.

title: THE CULT'S HR DEPARTMENT
readings: Welcome to the ancient order. The robes are itchy and the snacks are shit.
I questioned the sacred text. It was a dishwasher manual.

title: THE MUTUAL RED FLAGS
readings: Two souls. One terrible idea. Neither of us has read the tenancy agreement.
We wanted different things. I wanted hay. They wanted fewer inner mouths.

title: THE HIT-AND-RUN PROPHET
readings: Destiny has no brakes. I have written to the manufacturer.
I took control of my life. It is now sideways in a petrol station.

title: THE SUPPORT BRICK
readings: Gentleness is strength. So is my emotional support brick.
I tried to tame the beast within. It ate the little reward biscuit.

title: THE HERMIT WITH WIFI
readings: I withdrew from society. Society has sent a password reset email.
The light at the end of the tunnel is my unread-message counter.

title: WHEEL OF FUCK AROUND
readings: Round it goes. I have put my entire personality on the wrong horse.
The wheel stopped. The horse is still going. Please catch the horse.

title: THE FUCKING CONSEQUENCES
readings: The evidence is damning. Unfortunately I have signed it in hoofprints.
I ate the evidence. The jury has asked to see the horse.

title: THE HUNGOVER MAN
readings: A fresh perspective. Mostly ceiling. Please stop moving the ceiling.
I have learned nothing, but from an exciting new angle.

title: DEATH, BUT WITH ADMIN
readings: An ending approaches. Bring two forms of ID and a black pen.
I refused to let go. Death has opened a support ticket.

title: ONE MORE WON'T HURT
readings: Balance is important. I hold one terrible idea in each of my four hands.
I mixed moderation with poor judgment. It has eaten through the cup.

title: THE DEVIL'S PLUS-ONE
readings: The chains are loose. I stay because the buffet is fucking excellent.
I broke free of temptation. It has followed me home with a little bag.

title: STRUCTURAL FUCKING FAILURE
readings: A revelation from above. Mostly masonry.
The tower passed inspection. The inspector was three rats in a hard hat.

title: THE LAST FUCK TO GIVE
readings: A small light survives. I am guarding it with an unreasonable chair.
Hope is not lost. I put it somewhere safe and forgot where.

title: THE PARANOIA PONY
readings: Trust your instincts. Mine say the wardrobe has a second job.
The monster was a coat. The coat has requested an apology.

title: THE UNBEARABLE DAYSTAR
readings: Joy. Warmth. A bright new day to make the same bastard mistake.
My inner child wants to play. My outer horse wants the curtains shut.

title: THE FINAL PERFORMANCE REVIEW
readings: The dead have risen. Apparently this meeting could not have been an email.
I ignored the call. Heaven has left a passive-aggressive voicemail.

title: THE WORLD'S PROBLEM NOW
readings: The journey is complete. I have become an international fucking incident.
One final loose end. It is me. I am chewing the tapestry.

title: ACE OF SPITE
readings: A spark of inspiration. I have already singed the curtains.
The spark went out. I am blaming the curtains.

title: TWO OF SPITE
readings: Two paths ahead. I have brought a grudge for each.
I planned my escape. The door says pull.

title: THREE OF SPITE
readings: My ships are coming in. None of them should have passed inspection.
The horizon beckons. My parcel is still in customs.

title: FOUR OF SPITE
readings: A happy homecoming. Someone has changed the locks for the occasion.
The celebration has become a residents meeting. I have brought a brick.

title: FIVE OF SPITE
readings: Healthy competition. Five horses, one brain cell, no chairperson.
We agreed to disagree. I am disagreeing from the roof.

title: SIX OF SPITE
readings: A public victory. Please clap before anyone checks the arithmetic.
The victory parade has discovered the horse is the problem.

title: SEVEN OF SPITE
readings: Stand your ground. I have glued my hooves to the argument.
I chose this hill to die on. It is a fucking speed bump.

title: EIGHT OF SPITE
readings: Things move quickly. I have accidentally replied to all.
Everything is delayed. Even my rage is awaiting dispatch.

title: NINE OF SPITE
readings: Battle-scarred and still standing. The chair broke hours ago.
My last line of defence is a note saying please.

title: TEN OF SPITE
readings: I carry every burden. Four arms were an administrative mistake.
I put the burden down. It has asked for a lift home.

title: PAGE OF SPITE
readings: An eager apprentice. I have given the fire a little name.
Enthusiasm remains high. So does the smoke alarm.

title: KNIGHT OF SPITE
readings: I charge toward glory. Glory has asked reception to say it is out.
All thrust, no map. I have conquered the same roundabout twice.

title: QUEEN OF SPITE
readings: Warmth. Confidence. A deeply personal relationship with the flamethrower.
My charisma has become a small contained fire.

title: KING OF SPITE
readings: A bold leader sees the future. Mine contains a disciplinary hearing.
I demanded loyalty. The chair has joined the opposition.

title: ACE OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: My cup overflows. The carpet is having a spiritual experience.
Emotionally empty. Physically full of gas-station coffee.

title: TWO OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: A beautiful connection. We share a charger and several warning signs.
Two cups. One sink. This is how the war began.

title: THREE OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: Good friends raise a glass. Bad friends have brought a second horse.
The group chat has formed a smaller group chat.

title: FOUR OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: The universe offers a gift. I have asked for the receipt.
I finally noticed the opportunity. It was eating my sandwich.

title: FIVE OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: Three cups spilled. Two remain. I am grieving the carpet.
I stopped crying over spilt milk. The milk has started crying back.

title: SIX OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: A tender memory returns. It still owes me twenty quid.
The good old days have been checked. They were also bollocks.

title: SEVEN OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: So many possibilities. Every cup contains a smaller, angrier horse.
The illusion lifts. I have ordered seven identical problems.

title: EIGHT OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: I leave what no longer serves me. The buffet has filed an appeal.
I came back for closure. And the little cheese cubes.

title: NINE OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: A wish fulfilled. I should have specified a quiet horse.
I got everything I wanted. What an appalling clerical error.

title: TEN OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: Domestic bliss. We have agreed whose turn it is to be the problem.
The happy family portrait has requested separate frames.

title: PAGE OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: A message from the heart. It has hoofprints and no return address.
I expressed my feelings. The fish in the cup has called a solicitor.

title: KNIGHT OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: A romantic approaches. The white horse is me and I object.
Swept off my feet. Mostly because I tripped over the grand gesture.

title: QUEEN OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: I hold space for your feelings. They are leaking through the bucket.
My intuition says no. My mouth has already invited them to stay.

title: KING OF POOR DECISIONS
readings: Calm above the storm. Under the table I am biting a spoon.
Emotional mastery has been postponed until after my little tantrum.

title: ACE OF GRUDGES
readings: A moment of clarity. Unfortunately everyone heard me say it.
My razor-sharp argument has cut through my own trousers.

title: TWO OF GRUDGES
readings: A difficult choice. I have blindfolded myself to improve the process.
I refused to choose. Both problems have moved in.

title: THREE OF GRUDGES
readings: A broken heart. Three swords. Bit fucking excessive, honestly.
Healing begins. I have stopped using the heartbreak as a coat rack.

title: FOUR OF GRUDGES
readings: Rest is necessary. I am lying down with professional intent.
I rested my case. The case has developed insomnia.

title: FIVE OF GRUDGES
readings: I won the argument. Everyone has gone home without me.
I offered an olive branch. It still had a pointy bit.

title: SIX OF GRUDGES
readings: A quieter shore awaits. I have packed the trauma in a waterproof bag.
We crossed troubled waters. I brought a bottle of them back.

title: SEVEN OF GRUDGES
readings: A cunning plan. I have stolen my own keys as a distraction.
Caught red-hoofed. The alibi is also a horse.

title: EIGHT OF GRUDGES
readings: I am trapped by my thoughts. They have terrible taste in wallpaper.
The door was open. I have filed a complaint against my imagination.

title: NINE OF GRUDGES
readings: Three in the morning. My brain is rehearsing a conversation from 2009.
The nightmare is ending. Please do not give it my forwarding address.

title: TEN OF GRUDGES
readings: Rock bottom. At least the view has stopped getting worse.
I got back up. The floor has taken this personally.

title: PAGE OF GRUDGES
readings: A sharp young mind. Unfortunately attached to my fucking mouth.
I did my research. It was one furious pigeon.

title: KNIGHT OF GRUDGES
readings: I rush to defend the truth. The truth has asked me to slow down.
My argument arrived before my facts. It has started a fight.

title: QUEEN OF GRUDGES
readings: Clear boundaries. The moat is a useful visual aid.
I cut out the nonsense. There is very little horse left.

title: KING OF GRUDGES
readings: Reason rules. I have appointed a brick as an independent adviser.
Absolute certainty. Absolutely no supporting paperwork.

title: ACE OF DEBT
readings: A golden opportunity. It has a small monthly service charge.
I planted a coin. The garden now has a landlord.

title: TWO OF DEBT
readings: I balance my resources. Both are sugar cubes and one is imaginary.
The juggling has stopped. The bills are still airborne.

title: THREE OF DEBT
readings: Skilled teamwork. One horse builds, two horses hold the complaint.
We followed the blueprint. It was a napkin with a horse on it.

title: FOUR OF DEBT
readings: I protect my savings. Nobody is touching my emergency biscuit.
I loosened my grip. The biscuit has entered the free market.

title: FIVE OF DEBT
readings: Hard times. Even my imaginary money has a second job.
Help is available. I have reluctantly stopped insulting the helper.

title: SIX OF DEBT
readings: Give generously. I have donated an entire opinion.
The gift had strings attached. I am now a marionette.

title: SEVEN OF DEBT
readings: Patience bears fruit. Mine appears to be a threatening little lemon.
I dug up the seeds to check. They have requested privacy.

title: EIGHT OF DEBT
readings: Practise the craft. My hundredth horseshoe looks almost intentional.
I perfected the wrong skill. Witness my immaculate procrastination.

title: NINE OF DEBT
readings: Luxury earned. I am eating hay from the unnecessarily good bowl.
The finer things in life have arrived with a repossession notice.

title: TEN OF DEBT
readings: A lasting legacy. Generations will inherit my unfinished projects.
The family fortune was three buttons and a very confident envelope.

title: PAGE OF DEBT
readings: A practical student. I have brought a notebook and an edible pencil.
Lesson one: stop eating the school supplies.

title: KNIGHT OF DEBT
readings: Slow, steady progress. The horse has a spreadsheet and a flask.
Reliable as ever. Still reliably standing in the fucking way.

title: QUEEN OF DEBT
readings: A generous home. There is soup, a blanket, and a horse in the soup.
I cared for everyone. Someone please water the caretaker.

title: KING OF DEBT
readings: Material success. My emotional support brick now has a conservatory.
I own the whole stable. The stable owns every waking thought.
